author: Mench
body:
So, I was playing Justice. Decided to go for mounuments, but instead ending up killing above their spawn. Came up the ladder, DaBaderMC was behind me. Killed him. Camped there for a little, saw DaBaderMC going after me again, killed him. Killed him another. Then, just staying there typing my infraction. Please do not attack players right when they spawn!
  Even though I didn't kill the "players" right after they spawn. DaBaderMC went for me.
